canonical_name: No Redundancy of Information Processing Facilities
description: Information processing facilities are not implemented with redundancy to meet availability requirements.
applicability: Applies to organizations that do not implement redundant infrastructure components (servers, storage, network, power, cooling) necessary to meet defined availability and business continuity requirements for critical systems and services.

metadata.detection_notes: Review infrastructure architecture, high availability configurations, failover mechanisms, load balancing, geographic redundancy, single points of failure, availability SLAs, and disaster recovery capabilities.
